problem:
Consider the following matrices:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & -4 & -1 \\ 3 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}],\,D=[\begin{aligned}-6 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}],\,P=[\begin{aligned}-1 & a & 1 \\ 1 & b & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Given that $A=PD{P}^{-1},$ find the value of $\frac{a}{b}.$
